WALK ROW PROVENANCE: the new rows carry NO per-row comment - provenance IS the GT6RecipeMapDataB2ResidualRowsPourTest live-walk cross-check.  task recipe-b4-juicer-squeezer-flowerfruit appends its 13 BlockFlowersA/B run() rows (8 A :99-:106 + 5 B :100-:104, the Tungstus pair at the verbatim FL.Juice_Cactus.make(75) face; the DYE_FLUIDS_FLOWER outputs at CS.L = 144 mB, the LoaderItemList.java:757 IL.Dye_Cactus alias = green_dye). The :841-:853 vanilla red/yellow/double-plant dye rows REMAIN the smoke card's declared block (the flower/dye-items items are live since vanilla-alias-foodside - those rows wait on their owning card, not on items). KJS face: datapack-domain JSON, naturally moddable, zero adaptation. task smoke-juice-squeeze-vanilla-crops pours the declared residue band: 16 rows = Vanilla :841-:853 the 13 vanilla red/yellow/double-plant dye rows (the b2b2 squeezer identity mapping: red_flower metas 0-8 -> poppy/blue_orchid/allium/azure_bluet/red_tulip/orange_tulip/white_tulip/pink_tulip/oxeye_daisy, yellow_flower -> dandelion, double_plant 1/4/5 -> lilac/peony/rose_bush; DYE_FLUIDS_FLOWER at the CS.L=144 base, Loader_Fluids.java:122 — the gt6:dye_flower_ family, the b4 carrier; FL.mul x1 = 144, x2 = 288) + :855 cactus (Juice_Cactus 75) + :856 reed (Juice_Reed 75) + :874 squid ink (FL.make(squidink, 3*L/2) = 216). Every chanced item leg rides the vanilla-alias carriers: Remains_Plant = gt6:remains_plant (MultiItemFood.java:113), IL.Dye_Cactus = minecraft:green_dye (LoaderItemList.java:757), IL.Dye_SquidInk = minecraft:ink_sac (:756); the upstream chances land on the item-output slot (3000/6000/9000/5000 — the mChances-item rule; the :874 NI row is chanceless). SMOKE FACE CUT (the archaeology record): the upstream smoke domain is NOT a GT6 recipe map — it is the Et Futurum Requiem SmokerRecipes injection/blacklist shim (RM.java:805-821 the add_smelting aSmoker/aBlast legs; Loader_Recipes_Furnace.java:47-51 the map walk + :107-128 the blacklist passes), and the 1.20.1 port has no GT6 smoker map (the vanilla smoking recipe type is native datapack domain), so the domain is declared CUT here — no rows, no new map (the card ruling). KJS face: datapack-domain JSON, naturally moddable, zero adaptation.
